channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
item.description: A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: PowerPoint: Create on brand presentations with additional brand assets
item.description: Seamlessly access your brand colors, images, icons, logos and more right within PowerPoint to create on-brand presentations. (GA: July CY2026) — PowerPoint

item.title: OneDrive: Document library views now available in OneDrive
item.description: Users can now work with SharePoint document library views directly from OneDrive. In addition to switching between existing views, users can create and manage views to customize how library content is organized and displayed. This helps teams surface the information that matters most while staying w (GA: July CY2026) — OneDrive

item.title: OneDrive: New Shortcuts folder option when adding shortcuts
item.description: OneDrive makes it easy to add shortcuts to the files and folders you use most. Now you can choose to keep those shortcuts neatly together in one place instead of mixed in with everything else. When you add a shortcut, you can send it to a dedicated "Shortcuts" folder rather than your OneDrive root. (GA: July CY2026) — OneDrive

item.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Data – Granular access policy controls for custom attributes
item.description: We are introducing enhanced access policy management for Organizational Data in Microsoft 365. This update enables admins to release custom attributes to specific users or groups, rather than broadly to all employees or all managers. This provides a more conservative default approach for managing se (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting toolbar redesigned
item.description: The meeting toolbar in Microsoft Teams has been redesigned for customization, improving user experience during meetings. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP will introduce a File Quarantine action for SharePoint and OneDrive, moving sensitive files to a restricted location when policies are triggered. This feature impacts data protection for all users. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Data Security Triage Agent in IRM Enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview's Insider Risk Management will enhance the Data Security Triage Agent for better investigation accuracy, affecting security teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms up to 1,000 Attendees in Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms for up to 1,000 attendees in meetings, facilitating larger group discussions and engagement. This change impacts meeting organizers and participants. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
item.description: The Teams Meet app will allow users to discover and organize events within their organization. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium fea (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from th (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Block External Domain/User action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP will allow admins to block access to sensitive files for specific external domains or users in SharePoint and OneDrive, enhancing data security. This impacts compliance administrators. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Viva: New Post Creation Experience in Viva Enage
item.description: In Viva Engage, we've simplified how to create posts. The new post creation experience makes it easier and faster to share in Viva Engage with a cleaner, more intuitive publishing experience. It brings clearer layout, better accessibility, and smarter organization of tools—so you can focus on creati (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
item.description: Compliance admins can now create retention policies for Microsoft Planner content through the Purview compliance portal. This change affects compliance management for Planner users. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Content Sources in Copilot Chat
item.description: Users can now select specific content sources in Copilot Chat, limiting responses to those sources. This change affects users utilizing Copilot Chat. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Copilot Settings in classic Outlook for Windows
item.description: You will now be able to access different Copilot settings directly in classic Outlook for Windows. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
item.description: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a branded footer that displays the organization’s logo and an 'Approved by' label. This change affects administrators managing branding settings. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Co-Authoring Highlight and Rewrite
item.description: Users can now collaborate with Copilot to make improvements to email drafts. Select a section of the draft and ask Copilot to make changes, like changing its length, tone, or structure. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter - Simultaneous mode enhancements
item.description: We’re raising the bar on clarity and control with Interpreter. Admins can fully disable voice simulation via PowerShell when needed. Each speaker is automatically assigned a distinct voice, making multi-speaker conversations easier to follow. We’re reducing distractions by showing shimmer effects on (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents from returning a response when prompts contain sensit (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
item.description: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will now classify Azure RMS protected Office documents on Windows devices, enhancing data protection. This affects IT administrators managing DLP policies. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to preview content in Insider Risk Management Alerts
item.description: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview now allows users to preview content directly within alerts without creating a case. This change affects users with permissions in Insider Risk Management. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
item.description:
Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.
(GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
item.description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft 365: Change Meeting Organizer via PowerShell Cmdlet in Exchange Online
item.description: Exchange Online allows admins to change the organizer of meetings via PowerShell. This change impacts administrators managing meeting logistics. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
item.description: PowerPoint now allows users to attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in Agent Mode. (GA: July CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
item.description: PowerPoint now allows users to attach and reference images when creating presentations with Copilot in Agent Mode. This change affects users creating presentations. (GA: July CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Planner: Custom Templates
item.description: Planner will now allow users to create custom templates for projects, enabling reusable layouts tailored to organizational needs. This change primarily affects users who manage project planning. (GA: July CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved request flows for apps and agents blocked by admins
item.description: We are improving how users request access to apps and agents blocked by admins in Teams by introducing a clear, guided, and end-to-end request experience. This work reduces end-user friction by driving clarity into the request process and notifying users when there's been an update to their request. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Assistant field visibility in Organization view
item.description: Teams now displays assistant information in the Organization view on the profile card and in the Org Explorer, making it easier to identify a key support contact for executive coordination and scheduling. This designation is informational only and does not grant permissions, change roles, or affect (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Manage Built-in Teams agents in the Teams admin center
item.description: Admins will be able to manage Teams built-in agents across core Teams experiences, including chats, channels, and meetings, through a dedicated experience in the Teams admin center. From a centralized location, admins can control agents’ availability for users and groups. These agents will be enable (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across desktop and mobile devices, improving user expression. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) Support for Teams town halls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for streaming in town halls, improving video quality over the internet. This change affects users participating in Teams town halls. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Scoped Search for SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections)
item.description: With this feature, users accessing search through the Teams search icon while within the SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections) will be able to receive search result scoped to SharePoint global search. Hitting enter on the search query will then open the SharePoint search page. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: One-stop admin portal for Teams devices with Teams Rooms Pro Management
item.description: Admins now have a centralized portal for managing Teams devices, including health monitoring and analytics for both Windows and Android devices. This change impacts Teams device management. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on desktop screen and through mobile camera
item.description: Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on screen or camera. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. You can also use vision on mobile during a (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure data retention policy for Viva Glint
item.description: Glint service administrators can now configure data retention policies for various survey types based on organizational policies. This impacts admins managing Glint data retention. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-Room view control for Webinars & Structured Meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow presenters to control the front-of-room display during webinars, enhancing presentation management. This change affects presenters in Teams meetings. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Building level insights on the Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide building level insights in the Pro Management portal to help IT prioritize upgrades for BYOD meeting spaces. This change affects IT administrators managing Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space licenses. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Attend Microsoft webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android can now join Microsoft webinars and structured meetings, allowing interaction during events. This change affects users of Teams Rooms Pro. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Access: Design Access forms and reports without 22-inch size constraints
item.description: With the removal of the 22-inch limit, your apps can now take full advantage of today’s larger monitors. You can display more data, create flexible layouts, and deliver a better experience on wide and high-resolution screens. (GA: June CY2026) — Access

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Assign Open Shifts
item.description: Auto Assign Open Shifts is a Microsoft Teams Shifts feature that automatically fills unassigned (open) shifts for you. It lets managers automatically assign open shifts to available employees instead of doing it manually. The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, pa (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Copilot Chat leverages embedded images for richer, more accurate answers.
item.description: Microsoft Copilot can now interpret images in Word, PowerPoint, and PDF files to provide richer answers, enhancing user experience. This affects users leveraging Copilot for complex queries. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description:
The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.
(GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: ICS Preview experience
item.description: Outlook users can now import calendar events from ICS files and preview them before finalizing the import. This change affects users managing calendar events in Outlook. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced cross-platform join via SIP for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will gain the ability to join third-party meetings via SIP, enhancing cross-platform meeting capabilities. This update affects users of Teams Rooms Pro licenses. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Multiselect in the New Outlook and Teams calendars
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows and Teams calendars will allow users to select multiple appointments and meetings for bulk actions. This affects users managing calendars in these apps. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Viva: [Engage] Pinned resources & related communities in Teams for iOS
item.description: Teams for iOS will show pinned resources and related communities for users. This change affects mobile users of Teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management-Data Security Posture Agent in DSPM
item.description: The Data Security Posture Agent in Microsoft Purview helps data security admins discover sensitive data and assess risks using advanced analysis. This affects data security teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Exclusion List for data sharing
item.description: Viva Glint admins can now manage an exclusion list to prevent certain individuals from being included in data shared with Viva Insights, enhancing privacy controls. This affects Viva Glint administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Enhanced Rollout Waves
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps will enhance rollout wave functionality, allowing more than three waves and custom delays for updates. This change impacts admins managing update distributions. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Simplified Channel Management
item.description: Admins can now use device selection criteria in Cloud Update to streamline profile assignments and update channel management. This change simplifies the onboarding process for Microsoft 365 Apps. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved visibility and control for downloads
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating the download manager to improve tracking of file downloads, allowing users to manage downloads without interrupting chat actions. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS
item.description: Outlook will allow users to access Copilot directly while previewing files, providing smart suggestions and summaries. This change affects users who preview documents in Outlook. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Communities in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Viva Engage communities will now be accessible within Teams, facilitating connection and collaboration across the organization. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Upload custom backgrounds for Teams events
item.description: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools can now upload custom backgrounds in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. This enhancement allows organizations to display their brand identity by replacing the default backgrounds with their own images, such as co (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will disable the default profanity filter for live captions, affecting users who have not set a preference. This may result in unfiltered profanity appearing in captions. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: BYOD space peripheral health signals and reports in the Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admins can now manage BYOD peripherals with new health reports in the Pro Management portal, flagging issues like faults or missing devices. A Teams Shared Devices license is required for room reports. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
item.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Search in quick sharing experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling search within the quick sharing experience, allowing users to find and attach cloud files more easily. This affects all Teams users sharing files. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Enforce DLP protection upon new content before its saved
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enforce DLP protection on unsaved sensitive content, preventing it from being printed or moved. This impacts users handling sensitive information. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview expands DLP protection to Copilot and PC devices, allowing custom policies for Recall snapshots. This affects Purview admins and Intune admins managing these devices. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will receive a chat-first design update, improving user interface and navigation. This affects all mobile app users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
item.description: The Input Box in Microsoft 365 Copilot will simplify content insertion by displaying it as a pill, not repeating it in prompts. This affects users of the Copilot app. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Searchable keyboard shortcuts from the dialog in Teams
item.description: Easily find keyboard shortcuts with a new searchable experience in Microsoft Teams. Search by shortcut name or enter part of a key combination directly in the dialog. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick Share for Images
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Quick Share for images, allowing users to easily share visual content in chats and channels. This change affects all Teams users sharing images. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
item.description: Admins will be able to define a tenant‑wide default value for the Mail Compose and Reply setting that controls whether commas are used to separate recipients. Updated June 2, 2026: We are in the process of correcting an issue with setting the policy. We expect to complete in mid-June. Thank you for (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Teams meeting content can now be integrated into Copilot Notebooks, allowing users to reference discussions and decisions directly in their projects. This feature enhances the notebook experience for users across Microsoft 365. (GA: June CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
item.description: Users can create presentations directly from the PowerPoint Home using Copilot. This change affects all PowerPoint users. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
item.description: PowerPoint will allow users to create presentations directly from the Home menu using Copilot. This feature affects users who create presentations in PowerPoint. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide a standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files on mobile devices, improving performance and reliability. This change affects all Teams users on mobile. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: Outlook will allow users to manually select text and request Copilot for relevant information. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Automatically display auto-mapped calendars
item.description: Outlook will automatically display users' auto-mapped calendars when switching to the new Outlook interface. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: Authors can create interactive charts in SharePoint using AI by describing their desired chart in plain language. This feature affects SharePoint page authors. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Minimized meeting window enhancements
item.description: Teams will enhance the minimized meeting window experience, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. This affects all Teams users during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
item.description: In Microsoft Teams, recording and transcript owners can grant access to specific people for recap links without requests. This change affects users who share recordings and transcripts. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to co-create content or code in Pages using the tools menu. This affects users working with Copilot in document creation. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable customers to book appointments from a live chat widget on your website
item.description: The Teams live chat widget now allows customers to schedule appointments directly from a business's website. This change affects businesses using the chat widget. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
item.description: Users can now chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents directly within Teams chat, enhancing support and communication. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
item.description: Teams will have an efficiency mode that reduces resource usage on low-performance devices, improving meeting quality. This change affects all Teams users on constrained hardware. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
item.description: The Queues app will be available on Teams mobile, enabling call representatives to manage call queues and customer interactions on the go. This change affects mobile Teams users handling calls. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Book future meetings directly from Teams panels
item.description: Teams panels now allow users to book future meetings directly by selecting available time slots from the calendar. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
item.description: Outlook introduces a Go to Folder feature that enables users to quickly search and navigate to any mailbox folder by typing part of the folder name. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to test their microphone and speakers before joining a meeting. This feature helps ensure audio clarity for participants. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Identify bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers to see and control external bots trying to join meetings, enhancing meeting security for organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Instantly Find Rules, Quick Steps, and More by Name
item.description: Outlook introduces a name search feature for managing email automation tools like Rules and Quick Steps, making it easier to find items. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced issue detection in Teams Rooms on Windows and auto-remediation with Teams Rooms Pro Management.
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will improve issue detection and auto-remediation for meeting spaces. This change benefits IT admins by reducing troubleshooting efforts and ensuring room readiness. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will display notifications for critical issues affecting room functionality, helping users resolve problems quickly. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now preserve @mentions and shared contacts when copying and pasting messages, improving the accuracy of pasted content. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
item.description: You’ll notice media quality improvements including support for up to 16 participant videos (4×4 grid) available in May and simulcast streaming (June) when using Direct Guest Join. These updates make cross‑platform meetings more immersive and reliable when joining Teams meetings from Zoom, Google Mee (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Brand Impersonation Protection for Teams Calling
item.description: Teams calling will now include brand impersonation protection to identify potential phishing attempts from external users. This feature impacts enterprise users receiving calls via Teams. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
item.description: Meeting organizers in Microsoft Teams can now delete generated content like recordings and transcripts from the recap page using a new delete button. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks
item.description: Microsoft Teams will have improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks, making it easier for users to collaborate on code. This change affects all Teams users working with code blocks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows devices will support Miracast for wireless sharing, in addition to existing HDMI options. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams
